blocks.text: Written by: Vaughn Alviar Metro Cebu’s growth is creating opportunities beyond its established commercial centers. Through Gatewalk, South Coast City and Seagrove, Ayala Land and its development partners are bringing new mixed-use destinations to areas with distinct business, lifestyle and tourism prospects. Speaking at the Cebu Business Forum on October 14 at Seda Central Bloc, Jay Teodoro, Head of Vismin Estates at Ayala Land, discussed the opportunities emerging across the company’s Cebu developments. “Many commercial sectors continue to demonstrate growth and resilience,” Teodoro said, pointing to commercial property as another avenue for investors looking to participate in Cebu’s growth. “Businesses continue […]...
